articles.summary: A digital upload portal improves document transmission but does not eliminate verification work. For high-volume evidence types, structured verifiable evidence can reduce manual interpretation while improving provenance.
articles.title: From PDF Uploads to Verifiable Evidence: Modernizing Benefits Documentation

articles.summary: Knowing who an agent represents is not enough. Enterprises need to know what that agent is allowed to do, with authority that is granular, portable, and revocable.
articles.title: AI Agents Have an Authorization Problem, Not Just an Identity Problem
